name: identities-before-boot
argv:
set -u
rc=0
echo "## host"; uname -a; cat /proc/version; nproc; free -m; df -h / /mnt/c
echo "## ports (2222 8883 8000 8080 must be free)"; ss -ltn | grep -E ":(2222|8883|8000|8080) " || echo "none listening"
echo "## OS build artefacts (/home/ruisth/yocto/egw/src/yocto/build-integrated/tmp/deploy/images/qemuarm64)"
cd "/home/ruisth/yocto/egw/src/yocto/build-integrated/tmp/deploy/images/qemuarm64" && sha256sum Image-qemuarm64.bin egw-gateway-image-qemuarm64.rootfs-20260918120819.tar.bz2 \
  egw-gateway-image-qemuarm64.rootfs-20260918120819.ext4 egw-gateway-image-qemuarm64.rootfs-20260918120819.qemuboot.conf \
  egw-gateway-image-qemuarm64.rootfs-20260918120819.manifest || rc=1
echo "## data disk"; ls -l "/home/ruisth/yocto/egw-integrated/egw-data.img" || rc=1; /usr/sbin/dumpe2fs -h "/home/ruisth/yocto/egw-integrated/egw-data.img" 2>/dev/null | grep -E "state|features|mount count|Last mount"
echo "## rootfs ext4 state"; /usr/sbin/dumpe2fs -h "/home/ruisth/yocto/egw/src/yocto/build-integrated/tmp/deploy/images/qemuarm64/egw-gateway-image-qemuarm64.rootfs-20260918120819.ext4" 2>/dev/null | grep -E "state|features|mount count|Last mount"
echo "## QEMU"; Q="/home/ruisth/yocto/egw/src/yocto/build-integrated/tmp/work/x86_64-linux/qemu-helper-native/1.0/recipe-sysroot-native/usr/bin/qemu-system-aarch64"; sha256sum "$Q" || rc=1
if V=$("$Q" --version 2>&1); then printf "%s\n" "$V" | head -n 1; else printf "%s\n" "$V"; rc=1; fi
echo "## OS build source (Yocto checkout, launcher and kas)"; git -C "/home/ruisth/yocto/egw" rev-parse HEAD || rc=1; git -C "/home/ruisth/yocto/egw" status --porcelain | wc -l
cd "/home/ruisth/yocto/egw/src/yocto" && sha256sum scripts/run-qemu-integrated.sh kas/egw-qemuarm64-integrated.yml kas/egw-qemuarm64-integrated.lock.yml || rc=1
echo "## execution clone"; git -C "/home/ruisth/egw-exec/repo" rev-parse HEAD || rc=1; git -C "/home/ruisth/egw-exec/repo" status --porcelain | wc -l
cd "/home/ruisth/egw-exec/repo/src" && sha256sum deployment/scripts/collect-resources.sh deployment/images.lock.env deployment/compose.yaml || rc=1
echo "## host helpers"; sha256sum "$HOME/egw-tcg/itest-helpers.sh" "$HOME/egw-tcg/tunnel.sh" "$HOME/egw-tcg/ca.crt" || rc=1
echo "## controller image record"; I="${EGW_IMAGES_DIR:-/home/ruisth/egw-images}"; sha256sum "$I/egw-controller-0.1.0-arm64.tar" || rc=1; cat "$I/egw-controller-0.1.0-arm64.identity.txt" || rc=1
exit $rc

name: guest-state-after-boot
argv:
. "$E/scripts/session_common.sh" || { echo "STOP: the session ssh helpers ($E/scripts/session_common.sh) could not be loaded: NOTHING was run on the guest" >&2; exit 97; }
gssh "$1"

name: tunnel-down
argv:
{ . /home/ruisth/egw-exec/venv/bin/activate && set -a && . $HOME/egw-tcg/.env && set +a && export EGW_CLONE=/home/ruisth/egw-exec/repo && . $HOME/egw-tcg/itest-helpers.sh && . $HOME/egw-tcg/tunnel.sh && { tunnel_check || tunnel_up; } ; } || { echo 'STOP: the host preamble of runbook 6.1 (the venv, the secrets, the helpers and the tunnels) could not be loaded: the step never ran' >&2; exit 97; }
tunnel_down || true

name: stack-stop
argv:
. "$E/scripts/session_common.sh" || { echo "STOP: the session ssh helpers ($E/scripts/session_common.sh) could not be loaded: NOTHING was run on the guest" >&2; exit 97; }
gssh "$1"
cd /opt/egw/deployment && docker compose --env-file .env --env-file images.lock.env stop -t 60; rc=$?; echo "stop exit=$rc"; docker ps -a --format '{{.Names}} {{.Status}}'; exit $rc

name: oom-before-poweroff
argv:
. "$E/scripts/session_common.sh" || { echo "STOP: the session ssh helpers ($E/scripts/session_common.sh) could not be loaded: NOTHING was run on the guest" >&2; exit 97; }
gssh "$1"

if KMSG=$(sudo -n dmesg 2>/dev/null); then N=$(printf '%s\n' "$KMSG" | grep -ci 'memory cgroup out of memory' || true); printf '%s\n' "$KMSG" | grep -i 'memory cgroup out of memory' || echo 'no memory-cgroup OOM in this boot'; echo "memory-cgroup OOM lines: $N"; [ "$N" = 0 ] || exit 3; else echo 'dmesg could not be read: the OOM state of this boot is UNKNOWN, which is not "no OOM"'; exit 1; fi

name: artefacts-after-poweroff
argv: rc=0; sha256sum "$1" || rc=1; ls -l "$2" || rc=1; printf "%s\n" "$3"; exit $rc
